lean.title: Many matches at once
lean.hint: Lays hundreds or thousands of matches over each other, each from its own start. Their Parquet files (one a match, or files of many) are read straight into the GPU, never as a full table, so the overlay plays at full frame rate.
lean.name: {count, plural, one {# match file} other {# match files}}
lean.plannedThin: {samples} positions, more than fit: thinned to {keys} keys.
lean.limit.ram: {keys} keys (the memory free for the page)
lean.skipped: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} could not be read: {files}
lean.error.isoTime: The time column is text (ISO 8601): load these files through the Source panel instead.
lean.error.noPosition: The files have no position column.
lean.error.noTime: The files have no time column, and an overlay needs one.
lean.error.noUnit: The files have no column saying which unit a row is of (a track, player or id).
lean.error.tooBig: Even thinned to 25 m the positions need {detail} keys, more than this machine holds. Pick fewer files.
